scenario: certificate approaching its expiry warning window, certmonger reports a clean MONITORING state with no error
notes: IPACertmongerExpirationCheck is WARNING (approaching, not past, expiry) so cert-expired fires as a low-severity heads-up (WARNING bucket). The same evidence, combined with certmonger showing MONITORING and no ca-error anywhere (no CA_UNREACHABLE/CA_REJECTED/etc. state present), is also the documented signature for the renewal-master-unreachable hypothesis (cluster D): this host sees no local failure explaining why the cert isn't renewing yet, which per freeipa.org/page/Howto/Promote_CA_to_Renewal_and_CRL_Master can mean the CA renewal master replica (not this host) is the actual blocker. That is inherently unconfirmable from one host, so it stays UNKNOWN_INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE with severity ERROR (if true, this cert will keep aging toward expiry unnoticed), which makes it the sole PRIMARY candidate and pushes overall_status to UNKNOWN (an ERROR-severity, non-DIAGNOSED primary).
